english: Tap the camera to scan your first document.

english: This isn't automatic sync. Export creates a single encrypted backup file you move to your new device yourself, then import there.
target: 이것은 자동 동기화가 아닙니다. 내보내기를 하면 암호화된 백업 파일 하나가 생성되며, 이를 직접 새 기기로 옮긴 후 그곳에서 가져오면 됩니다.
backtrans: This is not automatic sync. When you export, one encrypted backup file is created; you move it to the new device yourself, then import it there.

english: Could not import this backup. Check the password and try again.

target: 이 백업 파일이 손상된 것 같습니다.

backtrans: DOCX sources are not displayed properly as pages — in-app saving is limited to JPG/PNG of images, PDF, TXT, CSV. Use export and share for this file. [??: awkward/garbled phrasing "JPG/PNG of images, PDF, TXT, CSV"]

target: 앱 안에 저장하려면 JPG 또는 PNG를 선택하세요. 다른 대상은 파일로 내보냅니다.
backtrans: To save inside the app, choose JPG or PNG. Other targets are exported as files.

backtrans: Tap a spot to sample the color

backtrans: Your device does not support the advanced document scanner. Take a photo with the camera app, then tap 'Import' below to crop and save it.

target: 결제 사용 불가 — 나중에 다시 시도하세요.

english: Language pack downloading or not ready. Try again shortly.

english: YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
backtrans: Documents are kept only on your device

english: Your entire document office — scan, edit, sign, and export — in one private app.
target: 스캔, 편집, 서명, 내보내기 — 모든 문서 작업이 하나의 비공개 앱에서.
backtrans: Scan, edit, sign, export — all document work in one private app.

english: Annotate, sign, watermark, fill forms, seal, and more — every tool free and unlimited.
target: 주석, 서명, 워터마크, 양식 입력, 인장 등 — 모두 무료 무제한.
backtrans: Annotation, signing, watermark, form filling, seals and more — all free and unlimited.

english: Use KatharScan in {count} languages. OCR runs on your phone — nothing ever leaves your device.
target: KatharScan을 {count}개 언어로 사용하세요. OCR은 스마트폰에서 실행되며 어떤 데이터도 기기를 떠나지 않습니다.
backtrans: Use KatharScan in {count} languages. OCR runs on your smartphone and no data leaves your device.

english: E-sign contracts, type-to-fill forms, and stamp enterprise seals in seconds.
target: 계약서 전자 서명, 양식 입력, 기업 인장을 몇 초 만에.
backtrans: E-sign contracts, fill forms, and corporate seals in seconds. [??: "기업 인장" = corporate/company seal; sentence is missing a verb ("do ... in seconds")]

english: Every edit stays reversible — undo, redo, and revert to original anytime.
target: 모든 편집은 되돌릴 수 있습니다 — 언제든 실행 취소, 다시 실행, 원본 복원.
backtrans: Every edit is reversible — undo, redo, restore the original at any time.

english: No account, no cloud, no watermarks. Your documents never leave your device.
target: 계정 없음, 클라우드 없음, 워터마크 없음. 문서는 기기를 떠나지 않습니다.
backtrans: No account, no cloud, no watermarks. Documents never leave your device.

english: Support KatharScan with a one-time purchase. All features remain free.
target: 일회성 결제로 KatharScan을 지원하세요. 모든 기능은 계속 무료입니다.
backtrans: Support KatharScan with a one-time payment. All features remain free.

target: 비소모성 구매입니다. 동일한 스토어 계정으로 언제 어디서나 복원할 수 있습니다.
backtrans: This is a non-consumable purchase. You can restore it anytime, anywhere with the same store account.

english: KatharScan ran into a problem displaying this screen. Your scans are safe — they're stored on this device and this doesn't affect them.
target: 이 화면을 표시하는 중 KatharScan에 문제가 발생했습니다. 스캔한 문서는 안전합니다. 이 기기에 저장되어 있으며 영향을 받지 않습니다.
backtrans: KatharScan ran into a problem while displaying this screen. Your scanned documents are safe. They are stored on this device and are not affected.

english: No folders yet. Tap the folder icon to create one.
target: 아직 폴더가 없습니다. 폴더 아이콘을 탭하여 만드세요.
backtrans: There are no folders yet. Tap the folder icon to create one.

english: No favorites yet. Tap the star icon on a document to add it.
target: 아직 즐겨찾기가 없습니다. 문서의 별 아이콘을 탭하여 추가하세요.
backtrans: There are no favorites yet. Tap the star icon on a document to add one.
Brightness [??: "명도" is lightness/brightness, abbreviated label "val" suggests Value]

english: Your feedback helps us grow and keeps the app free.
target: 여러분의 피드백은 성장에 도움이 되며 앱을 무료로 유지합니다.

backtrans: Welcome to KatharScan! This is the first public release, supporting unlimited scans, 29 languages, and export to PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG, CSV.

target: 확대해도 디테일이 늘어나지 않아 페이지가 흐릿해 보일 수 있습니다.
